title: Join an emitted native warp, child and scalar ADD with exact phase
body:
This enabling local proof joins an actual native warp, child transform and scalar ADD in the historical PR4088 emitted program. It completes one interface from [JoyboyBrian's released handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19234842): source 83 moves from frame 85 to 137, target 126 climbs from frame 0 to 137, then target -= source/2. **No new complete κ, selected assumption discharge or frontier change is claimed.** The global handoff remains open.

Review the [proof and local tensor identity](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b/research/emitted-native-boundary-join/PROOF.md), [serialized recipes and receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b/research/emitted-native-boundary-join/RESULT.json), [exact independent interpreter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b/research/emitted-native-boundary-join/verify.py), [source regeneration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b/research/emitted-native-boundary-join/produce.py) and [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b/research/emitted-native-boundary-join/SOURCES.json). Reviewed commit: `320c3bb73c5bdf231b6504dbe0cfe19410a78b8b`. Canonical main base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

The unchanged source emitter reproduces all 22,808 forward events and its retained SHA256. The new composition check covers zero-based events 6683–6685. The unchanged Clifford compiler produces one rank-zero warp and a rank-one child with two monomials. A separate coordinate-matrix implementation builds the expected endpoint from the actual source frames and operator columns. The new interpreter decodes the serialized recipes, including absolute phase, and agrees on all 1,024 two-bank input columns.

Writing A = T_85, B = T_137 and K = operator 52, the local identity is:

```text
(A s, t) -> (B K s, B (t - K s / 2)).
```

Its literal inverse restores both banks. For every positive tensor width f, replace A, B and K by their tensor powers and keep the coefficient -1/2 fixed. Constant monomial phase i^p becomes i^(fp). This is a local linear identity for arbitrary vectors, not a tensor power of the whole two-bank ADD matrix or an accelerated physical implementation.

At width one, the forward and inverse each use three monomial passes, 256 coordinate butterflies and 1,024 real scaled additions. At dimension N = 512^f, direct work is O(fN) with O(N) complex storage using separate arrays. These are arithmetic/address and macro counts, not a bit-operation, rounded-integer or tape tariff. Matrix preparation is verification work.

Validation used CPython 3.12.13 and `numpy==2.3.4`:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/emitted-native-boundary-join
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/emitted-native-boundary-join --check-source-history
```

Registered normal and optimized runs pass. The predecessor files require assertions and run unchanged in a normal subprocess in both modes; the new interpreter's checks run in both modes. All columns pass the endpoint and inverse checks. Four complex dirty pairs with integers wider than machine words also pass. Eight controls reject an omitted warp, omitted/reversed child, ADD before the frame change, wrong ADD sign and a changed constant phase in each of the three monomials. All six changed source files fail authentication.

```text
PASS_EMITTED_NATIVE_BOUNDARY_JOIN 1024 columns; 4 wide dirty pairs; 8 boundary mutations
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/emitted-native-boundary-join outcome=partial
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Metadata, 14 committed package/input files, source ancestry and the official export's integrity/six-input coverage pass. Hosted CI is pending at publication. The full 22,808-event numerical join, source backward/inverse-transpose orientation, all native phase stages, centre/endpoint/residual integration, production gather schedule, precision, tape, erasure, selected cold replay, independent human review and proof-kernel verification did not run. The tensor proof does not discharge any of those obligations.

Credit Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 for [PR #4088](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4088), historical head `72d7efc181edb21806a878f174847c96dd410ab0`, and the reference-change operators in [PR #2226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2226). The consumed [emitter](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/native/vendor/native/new/code/borrow/bw_emit.py), [coordinate oracle](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/native/vendor/native/new/code/borrow/bw_gauss.py) and [borrowing notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/native/vendor/native/new/code/borrow/NOTICE-PR2226.md) preserve icekylinx, DreamingOfClouds and the vendor531 compiler lineage. The proof links the complete retained native and supplier notices. Mark / @Matarener supplied [PR #4424](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4424), which already checks native warp classes and keeps global composition open; JoyboyBrian / @JoyboyBrian supplied the scoped handoff. No predecessor compiler, warp theorem, formal lift or supplier construction is claimed new.

Current all-state PR and Discussion searches found no competing implementation of this boundary. Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits. The next distinct obligation is an emitted centre or residual-wrapper boundary and then the global invariant. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363906). Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0.
